snippet.title: Minecraft Legends: Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The piglins are trying to corrupt the Overworld and turn it into a Nether wasteland! Are you the hero who will protect this gentle land? Start your legend at https://www.minecraft.net/legends
 
- Uncover an epic legend from the Minecraft universe 
- Form alliances, strategize, and defeat the piglins 
- Explore a lush, procedurally generated Overworld 
- Challenge your friends or team up in intense battles 
 
Developed by Mojang Studios and Blackbird Interactive, Minecraft Legends is an action strategy game available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5|4, Steam, Windows 11|10, PC Game Pass, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Xbox Cloud Gaming.
 
Learn more at https://www.minecraft.net/legends
